title: Director of Quality Assurance
text:
**Director of Quality Assurance** 
Location: 203A Log Canoe Circle, Stevensville, MD 21666 
Shift Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday 
Pay Range: $135,000 -175,000 + Bonus Eligibility!

**Hydrasearch,** a proud affiliate of The Dixon Group, is looking for a **Director of Quality Assurance** to join our team in **Stevensville, MD**! The Director of Quality Assurance will lead the organization's quality management strategy and ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. This role is responsible for overseeing quality assurance programs, driving continuous improvement initiatives, managing quality personnel, and partnering with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to maintain high standards of product quality and operational excellence.

**At Hydrasearch, we value the contributions of our Military Veterans and proudly employ our nation’s heroes. Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance function across the organization.
* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with AS9100D and ISO 9001, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Establish quality objectives, metrics, and reporting processes to drive continuous improvement.
* Oversee internal audits, external audits, and customer quality assessments.
* Manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs and root cause analysis initiatives.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership to improve product and process quality.
* Analyze quality data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint investigations and resolution efforts.
* Develop and drive supplier quality programs. Actively work with vendors to address quality concerns.
* Build, mentor, and develop quality personnel and future leaders within the organization.
* Support new product introduction activities by ensuring quality standards are incorporated into design and manufacturing processes.
* Prepare and present quality performance updates to executive leadership.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field required; Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within manufacturing, maritime & aerospace defense, industrial, or related industries required; experience supporting defense, military, or government-contract manufacturing environments preferred.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality teams and managing direct reports.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100D & ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Demonstrated success implementing continuous improvement programs and driving measurable results.
* Experience with root cause analysis methodologies and corrective action processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control methodologies is a plus!
* This hands-on leadership position requires extensive maritime and aerospace defense quality experience, strong knowledge of industry standards and regulations, and proven success managing external audits and compliance initiatives.

**What We Offer:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
* Competitive salary
* Bonus programs
* 401K retirement plan
* Training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement
* Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
* Gym reimbursements, and more!

**Who We Are:** Hydrasearch is a U.S. manufacturer specializing in fluid-transfer and control systems for maritime, aerospace, and defense applications. Since its founding in 1962, Hydrasearch has developed capabilities in hose assemblies, valve fittings, and customer machined parts, often to meet MIL-SPEC and naval standards.

**Join us and be a part of a team that values your contributions and supports your goals!**

**We do not provide sponsorships to work in the United States.**
